create_masking_generator: create a MaskingGenerator instance with input size and num_masking_patches parameters for vision transformer masking
generate_random_mask: call the MaskingGenerator to generate a random boolean mask array for a given number of patches
mask_rectangular_regions: use the _mask method to mask rectangular regions with configurable aspect ratio and area constraints
complete_mask_randomly: use complete_mask_randomly to fill remaining unmasked patches randomly until the target mask count is reached
get_mask_shape: call get_shape on a MaskingGenerator to retrieve the height and width dimensions of the mask grid
